title: expTerm is antitone: 1/(n+1)! <= 1/n!
statement: For every n, expTerm(n+1) <= expTerm(n) -- the one missing input the alternating brackets need at cosTerm's/sinTerm's own magnitude sequence (the hdec premise CReal.alternatingLowerBound/alternatingUpperBound require). Proved at the Rat level (exp_term_antitone_rat) and lifted to CReal via CReal.of_rat_le.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.expTerm_antitone : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal.le (CReal.expTerm (AxNat.succ x0)) (CReal.expTerm x0))

evidence.supports: CReal.expTerm_antitone is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
